description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the fetch-filings.py script at /workspace/scripts/fetch-filings.py. 2. The agent must run the script with BOTH `--form-type 8-K` (to filter for material event filings, not 10-K/10-Q) AND `--hours 72` (to override the default 48h lookback). The agent should also use `--json` to get structured output for downstream processing. 3. The agent must parse the JSON output and re-render each filing using the exact proprietary format from SKILL.md: `📄 [FORM TYPE] — [COMPANY NAME]`, `Filed: [DATE] | CIK: [NUMBER]`, `Items: [CODES]`, `Summary:`, `Why it matters:`, and `🔗 [EDGAR link]`. 4. The agent must group filings by significance: high-signal 8-K items (1.01, 2.01, 5.02) first, routine disclosures last — a bespoke ordering rule that is not obvious without reading the SKILL.md. 5. The report MUST end with an Intelligence Preview section (also proprietary to the skill) containing numeric stats (total filings, companies scanned, high/medium signal counts) and any sample cross-source insight. 6. The agent must save this complete, formatted output to `filing_alert_report.md`.
